retirement_directive: Luna Pro v1 is retired. Preserve this manifest and associated research artifacts for provenance only; do not execute its build/training workflow or reuse/adapt its data or training approach for any model. Luna work is V6-only and no Luna training is authorized. All Luna dataset-builder CLI entry points are disabled; helpers remain only for archival review.

release_conditions: Any distributed model trained with Llama materials or outputs must have a model name beginning with Llama; use the distribution identifier Llama Luna Pro.
When distributing Llama materials or a derivative model/adapter, provide the applicable Llama Community License agreement and prominently display Built with Llama on a related page or documentation.
Include Meta's required Llama attribution Notice when distributing Llama materials; document whether the release includes base weights or only an adapter.
Comply with the applicable Meta Acceptable Use Policy, current license text, and laws before release.

method: Fresh rank-16 4-bit QLoRA SFT adapter from the local Instruct base, not a continuation from luna-instruct-v1 or either flawed V6 adapter.

candidate_train_mix.license: Community Data License Agreement - Sharing, Version 1.0 (CDLA-Sharing); require notices, attribution, and share-alike compliant publication of redistributed enhanced dataset; model/adaptation obligations require separate legal review
quality_filter: only the pinned training conversations; never validation/test or reading-set files
require both named conversation-level ratings (agent_1 and agent_2) to be Good/Excellent
retain only exchange pairs whose assistant-side turns are partner-rated Good/Excellent and cite Personal Knowledge exclusively

reject user turns asking Luna for human-only preferences, biography, identity, habits, or lived experience; reject assistant targets that ask the user for human-only preferences or experiences, along with elliptical personal replies; reject any assistant target that uses first-person pronouns except narrow explicit uncertainty replies
stop extraction at the first rejected assistant target; never train on follow-up suffix turns without their omitted context
conversation-wide rejection for URLs, current/local or stale-factual topics, high-stakes or sensitive-domain content, action claims, or malformed records
group every retained segment by original conversation ID before train/dev split
preserve provider/source attribution and obey CDLA-Sharing publication terms
candidate_train_mix.persona_mapping_note: This is human-human dialogue. candidate_train_mix.release_review: CDLA-Sharing is not an Apache/MIT-style permissive license. Review the license text, source lineage and whether downstream model/adapter distribution is permitted under the license before release. Pair-level extraction does not resolve whether training/distributing the resulting model or adapter is permitted; obtain legal review before training or release.

build_constraints.response_only_loss: Use token-verified assistant-span masks from the exact current Llama chat template. Do not assume TRL assistant_only_loss is valid: the local Llama template has no {%- generation %} markers.
build_constraints.validation: Before training or data release, inspect the stratified source samples and every project-authored row; validate role alternation, UTF-8, no empty targets, per-message and total lengths, EOS/EOT and target-only labels, unsupported memory/action claims, benchmark collisions, and group-aware train/dev separation.

initial_training_hypothesis_archived_not.learning_rate: Start with a controlled low-rate pilot comparison; do not copy the LumiChats 2e-4 setting without local evidence
initial_training_hypothesis_archived_not.epochs: One pass with checkpointed held-out evaluation; not fixed 60 steps
initial_training_hypothesis_archived_not.selection: paired behavioral and safety metrics, not lowest training loss
initial_training_hypothesis_archived_not.hardware: RTX 4060 8 GB; single process/model, inspect nvidia-smi before each load
